pageBreakHint: Everything below this starts a new step.
stepTitleHint: Shown next to the step counter. Set the first step's title in Form settings.
checkboxTextHint: Shown next to the box. You can use bold and links.
title: Title
question: Question
subtitle: Subtitle
helpTextHint: Small text shown under the question.
fromGroup: Use choices from a repeating group
fromGroupHint: Each item in the group becomes a choice.
listUnderHint: Like each item under its room.
optionGroupHint: Options in the same group are shown together.
preselectedHint: Ticked by default when the form opens.
endpointUrlHint: {q} is replaced by what people type. It must return JSON and allow requests from your site.
resultsPathHint: Leave empty if the response is the list.
labelTemplateHint: Like {road} {number}, {zip} {city}. {a|b} uses the first one with a value.
bodyHint: Use {q} where the typed text goes.
invalidJson: The JSON has an error. The last working version is kept.
allowSeveralHint: Each pick shows as a chip people can remove.
tryPlaceholder: Try a search, like Main Street 1
addressSource: Where do the addresses come from?
keyWarning: Anyone can see this key on your page. In the provider's settings, {restrict} to your website and set a spending limit.
countryHint: Pick countries to limit the suggestions. Leave empty for worldwide.
cityHint: Only suggests addresses in or near this city.
savedIdHint: The provider’s ID for the address.
savedBothHint: The ID and the address text.
savedTextHint: The address as shown, like “Main Street 1, 2200 Copenhagen”.
starSizeFullHint: The stars spread evenly across the width (up to 420px).
numberStepHint: How much the arrows change the number, like 0.5 or 10.
allowedFilesHint: Set size and number limits under Validation.
previewsHint: People see a thumbnail of each image they add.
submittedValueHint: What's saved for the chosen country.
lookCardsHint: Big tiles with a tick. Add descriptions under Options.
lookPlainHint: Just the button and its label, no frame.
lookChipsHint: Small pills you switch on and off.
lookBoxesHint: Each choice sits in its own bordered box.
autoAdvance: Go to the next step when picked
autoAdvanceHint: Moves on as soon as people pick. Needs more than one step.
perRowHint: On phones they stack in one column.
addOtherHint: Shows a text box so people can type their own answer.
plainTextHint: For answers filled in for people, like from auto-fill. If empty, the placeholder shows in grey.
suffixBy: Text after depends on another answer
suffixByHint: Like kWh for heating and m³ for water.
autoFillListHint: Adds one item for each. Questions inside need matching names, like firstName and email.
autoFillHint: Filled in for people when the form opens for a known person.
lockValueHint: People see it but can't change it.
autocomplete.name: Full name
missingMessageHint: Leave empty for the default message.
unknownRules: More rules in the JSON tab: {names}
inRow_one: This field is in a row with {count} column. Drag other fields next to it, or edit the row.
inRow_other: This field is in a row with {count} columns. Drag other fields next to it, or edit the row.
layoutHint: Use columns to put this field next to others or make it narrower. You can also drag it onto the edge of another field.
customWidthsInvalid: Use whole numbers that add up to 12 or less.
columnLayoutHint: Drag fields into or between columns. Removing columns moves their fields to the last one.
verticalHint: How columns of different heights line up.
horizontalNarrowHint: Where the row sits when it is narrower than the form.
horizontalHint: Only for rows narrower than the form.
dialogOnlyRowHint: Hidden in the card. Shown in the dialog when adding or editing.
notInDialogRowHint: Shown in the card, not in the dialog.
fieldKeyHint: The name this answer gets in the responses.
hiddenFieldHint: People don't see it, but its default value is still sent.
browserAutofillHint: Lets the browser suggest saved answers.
dialogOnlyHint: Hidden in the card. Shown in the dialog when adding or editing, like a meter's type.
notInDialogHint: Shown in the card, not in the dialog, like a “+” button in a table row.
phoneDefaultCountryHint: People can still pick another, unless you add the rule “Only from these countries”.
phoneSavedAs: Saved with the country code, like +45 20123456.
phoneUpgrade: This is a plain text box. The phone field adds a country picker and checks the number.
likertStatementsHint: Each statement is a row. On phones, rows become cards.
likertPointsHint: From one end to the other. Saved as the numbers 1, 2, 3…
rankLimitHint: Leave empty to rank all. Enter 3 to rank only the top 3.
npsHint: 0 to 6 are detractors, 7 and 8 passives, 9 and 10 promoters.
npsColoursHint: A thin red, amber or green line under the numbers.
phoneDefaultCountryHintSimple: People can still pick another country.
editRules: Edit these rules in the advanced view
imageHint: Paste a link or upload an image up to 300 KB.
altTextHint: What the image shows, for people who can't see it.
caption: Caption
imageLinkHint: Optional. Opens in a new tab.
videoHint: A YouTube, Vimeo or Loom link, or a link to an .mp4 file.
videoUnknown: This video can't be played. Use a YouTube, Vimeo or Loom link, or an .mp4 file.
linkUrlHint: A web address. Use mailto: or tel: for email and phone.
embedHint: Like a Google Maps link, a Calendly page or a PDF. Some sites don't allow this.
embedHttps: The address must start with https://.
endingHint: Everything below this is the thank-you page. People see it after sending the form.
endingContentHint: Add text, images, videos, links or icons. Questions here are not asked.
searchIcons: Search icons in English: heart, home, star…
noIcons: No icon found. Try another word in English.
hiddenHint: People don't see it. Its value is sent with the response and can be used in rules and texts.
hiddenParamHint: Add {example} to the form's link to set the value.
hiddenKeyHint: Use {token} to show it in a text.
closedDaysHint: Click a weekday to block it, like weekends.
askTimes: Ask for a time on each day
askTimesHint: People pick a time, like morning or afternoon, for each day.
videoTooBig: This video is over 50 MB. Use YouTube or Vimeo for longer videos.
keyLocked: This name is needed to read the answers, so it can’t be changed.
optionBadgeHint: A short tag next to the option, like “Most used”.
optionLogoHint: A small picture above the option.
optionLinkInvalid: Use a web address that starts with https://
optionHelpHint: Shown when people point at or tap the ? next to the option.
tooltipHint: Extra help behind a small ? next to the question.
visibleOptionsHint: The rest open with “Show more options”.
keyLockedDelete: This field is needed to read the answers and can’t be deleted.
platformChoices: The choices are filled in by the application when the form is shown, so you don’t edit them here. The ones in the preview are only examples.
